$schema_doc: Each YouTube text poll is one object. The schedule-tweets skill picks up the first poll with status='pending' and posts it to YouTube's community section as a Poll post. Each poll captures a post_url after posting, then snapshots the vote tally after capture_results_after_days (default 14). Status flow: 'pending' -> 'posting' -> 'posted' -> 'captured' (results snapshotted) -> 'failed'. YouTube text poll constraints: question_text up to ~3000 chars, 2-4 options each up to 65 chars. YouTube polls do NOT auto-close; they stay open until the post is deleted. total_votes is populated when results are captured.
